title: Live review: rows POSTed by the direct path are invisible to live_review_due (and to packet context.previous_review)
note: [2026-11-15 06:32Z Manager 15a, from LIVE-REVIEW-20261115-0625 (session_01AFoLuLdsgiDQfznNR9gjS4)] MEASURED: catch-up reviewers at 04:06-04:15Z POSTed reviews by the DIRECT path. The VM handled them (receipts not_dispatchable action_hold) but they live only in runtime_logs/live_review/direct. Nothing exports them to the live-review/rows branch or main. live_review_due.read_reviews_merged reads main reviews.jsonl plus the branch only, so due reported bybit_2 BTC/ETH/SOL/ADA as 'never reviewed' and packet context.previous_review was null. XRP (0408) and SOL (0416) have a packet but no receipt anywhere: submitted nowhere, lost. Effect: duplicate catch-up dispatches, and reviewers miss prior context. Fix options: (a) the due index also reads the VM direct tree; (b) an exporter mirrors direct rows to live-review/rows. Done when a direct-path review clears daily_floor/judgement_cadence on /api/diag/live_review_due and appears as previous_review in the next packet. [2026-11-15 08:13Z Manager 15a] 2nd instance: LIVE-REVIEW-20261115-0808-ETH (pkg-858c60dc674d418f, LR-20261115T0804Z) POSTed direct (201, receipt handled/not_dispatchable) even though its dispatch named the branch path. The BTC reviewer in the same wake used the branch. So the brief currently lets a reviewer pick direct; the fix should also make the branch (or an exporter) the single path the due index sees. Asked the lane to mirror its row to the branch. [2026-11-15 08:14Z Manager 15a] 3rd instance: XRP reviewer (LR-20261115T0806Z-pkg-e20f6efc4b0b4bab) also POSTed direct. 2 of the 3 reviewers in the 08:00Z wake used direct, so every wake now risks duplicate reviewers on the next check. Raised to rank 2, assigned AM-OPS. [2026-11-15 08:16Z Manager 15a] CORRECTION: the reviewers are RIGHT. REVIEWER-BRIEF § 4a (TRADE-ACTION-DIRECT-PATH, operator 2026-11-12) makes the direct POST the primary submit and says 'Do NOT also write the branch file'. My earlier notes calling the direct submissions a reviewer defect were wrong, and so were my dispatch prompts naming the branch. THE FIX IS ONLY option (a): live_review_due (read_reviews_merged) and the packet's context.previous_review must read direct-path rows (VM runtime_logs/live_review/direct or the /api/bot/live-review/rows receipts). Reviewers stay as they are. Done when a direct-POST review clears daily_floor/judgement_cadence/trigger events on /api/diag/live_review_due and appears as previous_review in the next packet. Measured instances today: 04:06-04:15Z (4 rows; XRP 0408 and SOL 0416 have no receipt at all, a separate loss), 08:11Z ETH LR-20261115T0804Z-pkg-858c60dc674d418f and 08:12Z XRP LR-20261115T0806Z-pkg-e20f6efc4b0b4bab. [2026-11-15 08:35Z AM-OPS] FIX PR #26248 (5efb0ec2, Tier 2 hold, RESTART): read_direct_rows() + read_reviews_merged merges the VM direct tree after the branch (deduped by review_id); live_review_due reports direct_state/direct_rows_added; the packet's previous_review inherits it (same reader). Reviewer brief untouched. 3 new tests fail on main; 171 pass across due/packet/attention_watch. SEPARATE LOSS (XRP 0408, SOL 0416), MEASURED ict-web-api journal 04:00-04:40Z: exactly 6 'POST /api/bot/live-review/rows' requests, all 201 (04:05:47, 4x 04:10:37-38, 04:14:57), and receipts read back for 0401/0404-pkg-48c5cfab, 0405-pkg-858c60dc, 0406-pkg-85fa2fd8, 0406-pkg-ec406687, 0411-pkg-eb9ee0d2. No POST for an XRP package and none after 04:14:57 in the window. So the XRP 0408 and SOL 0416 rows never reached the VM: the reviewer sessions did not submit, it is not a VM-side drop (positive control: the same grep found the 6 that did). The loss is reviewer-side (session ended or POST not made); there is no VM fix. 2026-11-15 AM-OPS: #26248 merged 09:59:16Z as 6a8cb82570 (manager 15a). Merged, not yet deployed or observed; restart-relevant (decide RESTART), so it is live after the next trader restart / ict-git-sync. The observation that closes it: the first live_review_due envelope after deploy shows direct_state=read and direct_rows_added > 0 while VM direct rows exist under runtime_logs/live_review/direct/comms/live_review/rows/, and previous_review picks up a direct-written row. 10:10Z manager 15a: #26248 merged (squash 6a8cb825) and OBSERVED deployed: diag live_review_due now reports direct_state=read, direct_rows_added=47, branch_rows_added=56. Remaining done-condition: a direct-POST review clearing its package's events on the due list (next direct submission). 2026-11-15 11:20Z AM-OPS: DEPLOYED. The trader runs 46b0364f (#26262, 10:04Z); git merge-base --is-ancestor 6a8cb825 46b0364f is true (manager 15a checked the same). Still not observed: the live_review_due envelope with direct_state=read.
